
```{r}
# ====================================================================
# STEP 0: Load the Data
# ====================================================================
# Load the dataset exactly as you saved it from Phase 1
stars1 <- readRDS("stars_cleaned_eda.rds")

# ====================================================================
# STEP 1: PRE-PROCESS (LOCF on Long Data)
# ====================================================================
stars1_locf <- stars1 %>%
  # 1a. Sort chronologically for each student
  arrange(student_id, grade) %>%
  group_by(student_id) %>%
  # 1b. Safely fill fixed demographic traits backwards and forwards ACROSS ROWS
  fill(student_gender, student_race, birth_year, birth_month, .direction = "downup") %>%
  ungroup()

# ====================================================================
# STEP 2: PIVOT TO WIDE FORMAT (For MICE and Causal Inference)
# ====================================================================
# ====================================================================
# STEP 2 REVISED: PIVOT TO WIDE FORMAT (Keeping ALL Confounders)
# ====================================================================
stars1_wide <- stars1_locf %>%
  # 1. Select absolutely everything, but drop the manual lags if you want 
  # (because Wide format natively creates lags, e.g., math_score_K IS the lag for Grade 1).
  # If you want to keep them, just leave them in the time-variant list.
  select(-math_lag1, -math_lag2, -math_lag3) %>% 
  
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = grade,
    # 2. Put ALL time-variant variables here so they split by grade
    values_from = c(
      math_score, class_type, class_size, area_type, free_lunch,
      school_id, teacher_id, teaching_years, teacher_degree, teacher_career, 
      teacher_gender, teacher_race, 
      treads, tlists, wordsk, motivr, selfco, readbs, mathbs
    ),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{grade}"
  ) %>%
  # 3. Create the missingness indicator
  mutate(stayed_g3 = as.numeric(!is.na(math_score_3))) %>%
  # 4. Factorize (You will need to add the new categorical variables to this list)
  mutate(across(c(student_gender, student_race, 
                  starts_with("class_type"), starts_with("free_lunch"), 
                  starts_with("area_type"), starts_with("teacher_gender"),
                  starts_with("teacher_race"), starts_with("teacher_degree"),
                  starts_with("teacher_career")), as.factor))

# Quick sanity check
cat("New Dimensions of Wide Data:\n")
dim(stars1_wide)
```

```{r}
library(future)
# ====================================================================
# STEP 3: MICE Imputation (Imputing Z and A)
# ====================================================================
# We MUST drop student_id from the imputation process, otherwise MICE 
# will try to use the student's ID number as a numeric predictor, 
# which will ruin the math and take forever to run.

# We create a specific dataset just for MICE by stripping out the math hazards:
# 1. Drop all IDs (Student, School, Teacher)
# 2. Drop class_size (redundant with class_type)
# 3. Drop stayed_g3 (we will use it later in WeightIt, not here)
stars_mice_input <- stars1_wide %>%
  select(
    -student_id,
    -starts_with("school_id"),
    -starts_with("teacher_id"),
    -starts_with("class_size"),
    -stayed_g3
  )

cat("Running Parallel MICE Engine... (Unleashing the 9800X3D!)\n")

imp_data <- futuremice(
  stars_mice_input, 
  m = 20, 
  maxit = 20, 
  parallelseed = 2026207,      # 保证并行计算结果可重现

)

# 跑完后关闭并行池，释放后台资源（好习惯）
plan(sequential)

# Check if it succeeded!
cat("Parallel MICE successfully completed!\n")
```

```{r}
# ====================================================================
# STEP 4: The MID Maneuver (Imputation then Deletion)
# ====================================================================
# 1. Extract the long format of the imputed data
long_data <- complete(imp_data, action = "long", include = TRUE)

# 2. Grab the dropped columns (student_id and stayed_g3) from the original wide dataset
# We create a matching .id column based on row numbers
stars_dropped_cols <- stars1_wide %>%
  mutate(.id = row_number()) %>%
  select(.id, student_id, stayed_g3)

# 3. Join them back into the long MICE data, and do your brilliant MID Deletion Step
long_data <- long_data %>%
  left_join(stars_dropped_cols, by = ".id") %>%
  group_by(.id) %>%
  mutate(math_score_3 = math_score_3[.imp == 0]) %>% 
  ungroup()

# 4. Convert back to a MICE 'mids' object so the causal packages can read it
imp_data_mid <- as.mids(long_data)

# Sanity Check
cat("\nMID Complete! Checking missingness in Imputed Dataset #1:\n")
cat("math_score_3 NAs (Should be thousands): ", 
    sum(is.na(complete(imp_data_mid, 1)$math_score_3)), "\n")
cat("free_lunch_K NAs (Should be 0, fully imputed): ", 
    sum(is.na(complete(imp_data_mid, 1)$free_lunch_K)), "\n")
cat("Did stayed_g3 successfully reattach? (Should be TRUE): ", 
    "stayed_g3" %in% colnames(complete(imp_data_mid, 1)), "\n")
```

```{r}
# ====================================================================
# STEP 5 (终极版): 使用你指定的 71 列中最相关的 K-G2 变量
# ====================================================================

# 1. 定义你刚才列出的这个完美公式
formula_seaman_full <- stayed_g3 ~ 
  student_gender + student_race + birth_year +
  math_score_K + math_score_1 + math_score_2 +
  treads_K + treads_1 + treads_2 +
  tlists_K + tlists_1 + tlists_2 +
  wordsk_K + wordsk_1 + wordsk_2 +
  teacher_degree_K + teacher_degree_1 + teacher_degree_2 +
  teaching_years_K + teaching_years_1 + teaching_years_2 +
  class_type_K + class_type_1 + class_type_2 +
  free_lunch_K + free_lunch_1 + free_lunch_2 +
  area_type_K + area_type_1 + area_type_2

cat("Running the full Seaman & Vansteelandt weight model...\n")

# 2. 运行权重模型
weights_full <- weightthem(
  formula_seaman_full,
  datasets = imp_data_mid,
  method = "ps",
  estimand = "ATE",
  approach = "within"
)

# 3. 验证平衡性
# 如果这个长公式运行成功，你的蓝点应该会非常漂亮地对齐
love.plot(weights_full, stats = "m", threshold = .1, abs = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# ====================================================================
# STEP 6: 最终的 Doubly Robust 估计 (符合计划书 Defense 2 规范)
# ====================================================================
library(mice)

cat("正在运行符合 Seaman (2018) 规范的结果模型...\n")

# 1. 在加权后的 20 个数据集上运行线性回归
# 根据计划书第4页要求：显式包含 Class_Size * Grade 的交互逻辑 (此处以 math_score_2 作为代理)
fit_dr <- with(weights_full, 
               lm(math_score_3 ~ class_type_3 * math_score_2 + 
                  # 计划书要求控制的其他三年级混杂因子
                  free_lunch_3 + area_type_3 + 
                  teacher_degree_3 + teaching_years_3 + teacher_race_3 +
                  # 加入基线特征以提高效率 (Efficiency)
                  student_gender + student_race + math_score_K))

# 2. 依照 Rubin's Rules 进行池化合并
final_pooled_results <- pool(fit_dr)

# 3. 打印最终因果效应
cat("\n========================================================\n")
cat("   FINAL DR ESTIMATE (Project STAR Year 3)              \n")
cat("========================================================\n")
# 提取小班教学(Small Class)的效应量
summary_df <- summary(final_pooled_results, conf.int = TRUE)
print(summary_df[summary_df$term == "class_type_3Small class", ])
```
